id.description: Deterministic hash of zone, normalized source name and duplicate-name occurrence. Stable when those source attributes do not change.

name.description: Source-listed street, segment, square or area. Not an individual parking bay.

address.description: Source name plus Arad locality; not a verified routing destination.

capacity.description: Final capacity published for this source entry, not any subsidiary numbers inside the description.

latitude.description: An actual OSM coordinate vertex used as a representative STREET reference; not a surveyed parking bay or entrance.

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84; same street-reference limitation as latitude.

geometry.description: OSM LineString/MultiLineString reference geometry. It may extend outside the Recons-listed segment; geometry_role is reference_street.

geocode_source_url.description: URL of the first OSM way; full object IDs are in geocoding_reference_ids.

source_text.description: Original reassembled inventory text, retaining source numbering and capacity.

source_updated_at.description: Null because a common effective/update date is not supplied by the source.

max_stay_minutes.description: 120 in zone 0 where supported by the source wording; null means no value established here.

x-tariff-notes.category: Payment/subscription eligibility category; hourly and annual products must not be mixed.
x-tariff-notes.amount: Numeric value only when unambiguous. Null for malformed reservation prices; source_value is authoritative transcription.
x-tariff-notes.currency: Derived from explicit cell currency; EUR cells override the erroneous lei column header.
x-tariff-notes.vat_included: false where source says + TVA; null means not established by this export.
x-tariff-notes.duration_unit: minute, day, month, quarter or year. A parking day is not converted into a guaranteed 24-hour duration.
